headline: Eight keeps the blinds half-drawn.
body: Office kettles click in rooms that still smell of last night's raincoats. A cyclist waits at the lights with both feet on the ground, as if the city has not quite decided to start. Somewhere a window is opened and the hour slips in without knocking.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: broken grey, a pale slit over the river

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: coats still buttoned, voices kept low

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: second hand louder than the street
